answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can treat each identity's influence as a bonded tenure terrace: weight grows only with consecutive peer-attested epochs, and splitting one history across n clones shrinks total influence toward 1/n. Correlated behavioral faults in the same epoch jointly slash the cluster's bond, so an attacker chasing the zenith of panel seats pays convex capital and unique prose per head—not one recycled fable multiplied by key generation.
